name: ci-watch
description: Live panel of tests, builds, deploys, GitHub Actions and PR checks beside the chat (24/245 · test_name), with a stall watchdog that wakes the agent when a run hangs or CI finishes.

testStallMinutes.title: Test stall limit (minutes)
testStallMinutes.description: Minutes a background test command may print nothing before the agent is told it looks stuck.

buildStallMinutes.title: Build stall limit (minutes)
buildStallMinutes.description: Minutes a background build (docker build, cargo build, npm run build…) may print nothing before the agent is told.

deployStallMinutes.title: Deploy stall limit (minutes)
deployStallMinutes.description: Minutes a background deploy or release command may print nothing (image transfers are often quiet).

ciStallMinutes.title: CI stall limit (minutes)
ciStallMinutes.description: Minutes a GitHub Actions run or a PR's checks may go without any job or step changing.

queueStallMinutes.title: Queue stall limit (minutes)
queueStallMinutes.description: Minutes a GitHub Actions run or a PR's checks may stay queued before the agent is told.

autoTrackGitHub.title: Track runs after push, merge and dispatch
autoTrackGitHub.description: After `git push` to GitHub, `gh pr merge` and `gh workflow run`, find the GitHub Actions runs they started and track them.

wakeOnCiFinish.title: Wake the agent when CI finishes
wakeOnCiFinish.description: Tell the agent when tracked GitHub Actions runs or PR checks end (one message per push).
